request: Turn this engineering note into an email to the customer, Maria, the office manager at Acme. She is not technical.
input:
Eng note, 2026-11-17, re: Acme export issue, case CS-881.
CSV export times out for accounts with more than 50k rows, because the export query does a full scan on invoices_lines without the tenant index. Acme has 72k rows. Workaround: export one month at a time with the date filter on the Export page. Each month is under 50k rows. Fix: composite index added in PR #3190, in review. If it passes QA it should probably ship in the Friday release (2026-11-21), but QA is backed up, so maybe the week after. Don't promise Friday. - Duc
